description: git-guardrails Claude Code hooks. PreToolUse on Bash refuses commands that switch the git guardrails off or dodge them (writing core.hooksPath or guardrails.*, exporting GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH, --no-verify, any force push, git branch -D, git worktree add outside <repo>/.worktrees); it never prints 'allow', so normal permission prompts stay intact. Stop blocks once when the current branch has commits origin does not have (stop_hook_active is respected, so it never loops). The rules themselves are enforced inside git by git-hooks/guardrails.py via core.hooksPath - install with bin/install-git-guardrails (dry run by default, --apply to write).
